_about: Eight female figures for the stage cards, as SVG markup fragments.
One silhouette, re-posed per stage: she is always doing something, never
cowering - this is a page about using a system, not about being a victim
of one. Single colour: everything inherits the card's `color`, so one CSS
rule switches a whole figure to the accent.
Classes: f = filled body parts, l = limbs, o = outlined props.
Each icon is assembled as:  <g [shift]>body + arms</g> + prop
arms     raw markup, when the pose is used once
prop     what she is using, drawn at x 40-62 of the unshifted grid
shift    false keeps the figure centred even though it has a prop
A figure with a prop is shifted left by `propShift` to make room for it.
Attributes use single quotes so the markup stays readable inside JSON;
double quotes work too if you escape them as \".

standing._note: 1 standing, nothing in her hands - where it starts

writing._note: 2 bent over a form she is filling in
writing.prop: <rect class='o' x='40' y='26' width='16' height='19' rx='2'/><path class='o' d='M44 33h8M44 38h8'/>

receiving._note: 3 taking a stamped page from the court
receiving.prop: <rect class='o' x='40' y='20' width='16' height='19' rx='2'/><circle class='f' cx='48' cy='29.5' r='3.2'/>

waiting._note: 5 beside a calendar - a date is given

holding._note: 7 holding up the order she was granted
holding.prop: <rect class='o' x='40' y='7' width='17' height='19' rx='2'/><path class='o' d='M44.5 16.5l3 3 6-6.5'/>

calling._note: 8 holding up the order he has broken - deliberately the same pose and the same page as 7, so the pair reads as one thing: granted, then breached. Only the mark on the page changes, tick to cross. The key is still 'calling' so poprocess.json needs no edit; rename it in both files if you prefer.
